hook: One hundred years ago, a new central bank in Prague changed monetary history forever.

sections.voiceover: One hundred years ago, a new central bank in Prague changed monetary history forever.
b_roll: Archives of the National Bank of Czechoslovakia

sections.voiceover: On April 1, 1926, the National Bank of Czechoslovakia officially opened its doors. Operations began during a volatile era for European finance. Where did the 1926 mandate lead this institution?
Except the evolution did not stop after the post-Bretton Woods system transformed global markets.
Deputy Governor Jan Frait delivered remarks at the Prague conference on October 6, 2026. Modern currency systems now face the legacy of that 1926 foundation.
Study the 1926 establishment to understand modern central banking.
